backendConclusions: Schema5 feed uses INSERT arrivals only; existing stable IDs are backfilled. Same-ID UPDATE/refinement/read/ACK does not allocate an arrival. FK deletes remove feed rows without resetting sqlite_sequence.

Cursor syntax and decimal bounds are checked before domain baseline. Every observed sequence through the high watermark is consumed, including invalid/future/other-day/expired/ineligible/overflow; selected output stays bounded to8 and dropped classes remain explicit.

Future events becoming current and unknown-to-known updates cannot re-enter the arrival feed. Reads do not acknowledge or mark Inbox entries read. Existing Inbox/count semantics remain independent of prompt selection.

Core C18 wrappers preserve explicit Shanghai-day/settings time, success-only decimal revision, future-version rejection and consistent pre-upgrade backup plus pending-DDL transaction. clear_inbox and its scope watermark are atomic.

Details validates day/runtime/source domain and preserves native alias/excluded/cache/null semantics. Desktop quota projection is a small cached read under the same validated Core source binding, starts no RPC and rejects disabled/old-root binding.

Successful domain-mutating actions invalidate the frontend immediately through petDomainChanged before optional bridge-cache cleanup waits. Both command-handler configurations include the finite read-model commands.
frontendConclusions: App splits Main/Pet before hooks. Pet does not instantiate useApplication, a panel Query or full Snapshot; main retains the existing panel path.

Each usePetStore effect setup owns a new PetReadLifecycle. Late subscriptions, RAF callbacks and replies are fenced and all effect-owned resources are disposed; StrictMode cleanup cannot revive an old owner.

Pulse requires strict string domain/revision/cursor fields and rejects same-domain revision<=the last accepted revision. Generation/serial/day/asOf checks occur before acceptedAt or cursor commits, so an invalid or old reply cannot renew observation freshness.
Initial, hidden, DND, source/day/runtime change, clock rollback and observation-gap paths retain baseline/suppression behavior. Null or not-ready presentation is not a confirmed empty event batch.

CatGirl and Care receive the same immutable accepted prompt batch. Their rendering watermarks are independent consumers; consuming the persistent read cursor is distinct from animation acknowledgement. Only CatGirl actual prompt start invokes acknowledge_delivery.

Details is requested only while the card is open and the pet is visible/ready. Close, settings/domain/clock change and disposal invalidate late results; the card uses explicit not-ready placeholders rather than stale facts or invented zero totals.
WorkCare DOM visibility/popover callbacks do not renew retained facts. Only a fresh accepted presentation updates observation time, preserving the manual-tap stale guard and finite bubble lifetime.

limitations: No material blocker was found within these specific read-model, migration, wiring and consumer paths; this is not a claim that all product behavior is defect-free.

Review did not execute tests, browser IPC, application, account RPC, installer, real-source scan or performance measurement. Existing tests are referenced evidence rather than fresh executions by the reviewer.
Browser IPC remains for the root separate receipt. A Browser fixture cannot qualify production Core/SQLite, native rendering, real CSV save, account compatibility, OS delivery or Windows lifecycle.

No C18 native/P95/renderer resource/full-import/warm-start/idle/installation or whole M4 pass is asserted. Historical C12-C16 failures and incomplete measurements remain unchanged and cannot be transferred to this candidate.
Pulse candidate/output storage is bounded, while scalar traversal still depends on source/turn/inbox size; source review and unit test timings do not establish resident memory or latency improvement.
Details is an independent same-domain on-demand channel, not a promise that its revision equals the latest Pulse revision; in-flight data can remain asOf-stale within the explicit freshness checks.
